newsitem.title: UK: TEAMSTER UNION SEEK EUROPEAN SUPPORT ON UPS STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: TEAMSTER UNION SEEK EUROPEAN SUPPORT ON UPS STRIKE.

text.p: European unions representing United Parcel Service are being contacted over support for the company's U.S. Teamster employees three-day old strike, a Teamster official said.
"We're still getting things in motion," Teamster international affairs coordinator, Andy Banks, told Reuters in reply to a question as to what he expected this support would be.

Banks, who arrived in London earlier on Wednesday, said there will be another three or four staff coming from the U.S. They will be operating out of the London headquarters of the International Transport Workers Federation (ITF).
"We'll definitely be visiting Germany early next week, while Belgium, France, Italy and the Netherlands are also likely to be visited. You would be surprised at the solidarity," he said.
The visit to Germany will include Mannheim, the Frankfurt area and also the company's European hub at Cologne next Tuesday, he added.
He added that discussions were under way for a possible meeting of the ITF-UPS World Council.

This was set up in early February 1997 in London as a global body by unions -- including the Teamsters -- from a number of countries to coordinate their dealings with UPS. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
